rows.subtype: Approach: hiding worry and carrying it alone [Pitfall]
rows.description: The teen says nothing and pretends everything is fine, while stress builds and marks fall. Parents, unaware of the burden, cannot offer reassurance or help share the load.

rows.subtype: Approach: demanding things regardless of family condition [Pitfall]
